(2) max_devices_per_member defaults to 2, stored in gym document. (3) Devices are stored in member_devices collection with fields: id, member_id, gym_id, device_fingerprint, user_agent, device_name, active, registered_at, last_active. (4) Admin can view/deactivate devices from member dropdown -> Dispositivos. (5) PWA has quick nav buttons on home page linking to /app/stats, /app/classes, /app/history. (6) Stats page uses recharts for 6-month visit chart.
